notes.title: Servers are closed
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754844/b514875305a24bcb302bbc676e99823c2735ea77.png[/img] 
Our servers are closed now and we thank you all for your participation during and after the Steam Next Fest. We hope you had as much fun as us fighting monsters and making loot in PvE or just enjoying old-fashioned PvP duels. 
And for those of you who didn't get a chance yet to play the game, no worries: the next playtest is not far away. In the meantime we are working on implementing the feedback collected from you and on additional content and features. Stay tuned for more news and see you soon, SoulCasters!

notes.title: Our servers are still open
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754844/69a6ae91db313bf67bb5ceda90efcd3d6a6d15c5.png[/img]
Steam Next Fest may have ended, but the battle is far from over! Servers will stay open a little longer for all Soulcasters. So if you have a key for the base game, try out our new PvE game mode if you haven't already or play some more PvP. And for those of who you don't have a key yet, but would like to test the game, don't worry, we distribute test keys regularly.
In the mean-time we will collect the feedback from our players and do the necessary adjustments to gameplay while working on more content. We will share more information soon, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Descend into the Dungeon
notes.notes:
Soulcast will be featured at Steam Next Fest, from [b]9 -16 October[/b], and on that occasion we have big news to share! After months of hard work, we are finally ready to unveil what we have been up to all this time. We present to you: [b]Expeditions[/b], a brand-new game mode featuring procedural dungeons, PvP and PvE gameplay and a whole host of AI enemies. So without further ado, let’s dive into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754844/cfe58f6c655d98ced6da285865cbb667cf8d20ab.png[/img]
[h3]What are Expeditions?[/h3]
Expeditions are essentially a dungeon mode where players band together in raiding parties with other adventurers to venture into a vast labyrinth of passages and interconnected chambers, deep below the surface of Abaddon. These environments are procedurally generated, combining different types of rooms and random enemy spawn points to create unpredictability. 

As players slowly make their way through the dungeon, they never know what lies in store for them in the next chamber. It could be loot and consumables, but it could also be a room full of lethal traps or a swarm of bloodthirsty creatures with an appetite for careless explorers. And if that wasn’t enough, there is the constant danger of ambushes from rival teams, turning the gameplay from simple PvE Coop into full-fledged PvPvE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754844/c8caa7de8e8b77d63f4447011ca0f3b01cb2f0d2.png[/img]
[h3]How do Expeditions work?[/h3]
The goal of an expedition is simple: make loot. How exactly you approach this, is up to you and your team: Do you want to play it safe by slaying some smaller monsters and clearing some of the outer rooms before heading to the next exit? Or do you dare to venture ever deeper to find the central chamber, a place rumoured to be filled to the brim with ancient artefacts, powerful weapons and magic-infused gemstones?
 
Both options are viable, but as you would expect, increased rewards come with a higher risk: Like every self-respecting treasure room, the central chamber is guarded by a boss that needs to be defeated first. So get your teamwork going, flex your skills and show that boss who is boss.
Once you have what you came for, the only thing left to do is getting out of the dungeon through one of several exits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754844/b8ab8e23b4dbc57d15c077317b6556e8710cd93c.png[/img]

This is all for now, we hope you are going to give this new mode a try! For the duration of the [b]Steam Next Fest Stay from 9 -16 October[/b], the servers will be open around around the clock for you to test the Expeditions mode or jump into PvP via our overhauled lobby. As you log into the game you will notice that there have been a lot of improvements to the game, including a much more detailed character creator which allows you to choose different hair styles, beards and eye colours. 

We have implemented a lot more changes, so we invite you to stay tuned for more news, including a detailed look on features like procedural levels, the types of AI enemies and bosses awaiting you in the depths and the looting system that will reward players for their adventurousness.
